purpose: Teach: 文春/獅子/宇都宮/旭川/尼崎/豊田/西ドイツ/出雲

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが文春の記事をお持ちなのよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad has an article from Bunshun he wants to show you.
lines.style: Warm, conspiratorial tone. Gently amused at being the messenger. Settles back in her chair, watching his reaction with soft attention. Patient cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと獅子舞見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see the lion dance with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, urgent appeal. Immediate energy burst on the opening word. Bounces slightly forward. Barely contains his excitement. Quick, eager pace with a hopeful lift at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宇都宮餃子を食べに連れて行って下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he's going to take you to eat Utsunomiya gyoza.
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Measured reveal, like unwrapping a gift slowly. Warm but calm. She's enjoying his anticipation. Slight dramatic pause before the treat.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと旭川動物園行きたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go to the Asahikawa Zoo with Dad!
lines.style: Fresh burst of hope on a new idea. Same bright energy but slightly higher register than before. Leans in with genuine longing. Quick, earnest delivery. The word 'Dad' carries particular weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが尼崎にお出張なさるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad has to go on a business trip to Amagasaki.
lines.style: Gentle, regretful shift in tone. Still warm but tempered. Slower pace. She's delivering news that she knows might disappoint him. Careful, kind intonation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと豊田の自動車工場見学したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I already went to see the Toyota car factory with Dad!
lines.style: Proud announcement with underlying relief that this one already happened. Brighter than the last exchange. He's sharing a victory. Slight emphasis on 'already' — he has this memory locked in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが西ドイツ時代のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad is going to tell you stories about his time in West Germany.
lines.style: Nostalgic warmth. Slower, more reflective pace. She's offering something precious — a window into the grown-up world. Settles in like this matters. Gentle, reverent delivery.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと出雲大社にお参りしたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go and visit Izumo Shrine with Dad!
lines.style: Softened hope at the close of the sequence. Still eager but with a deeper, more reverent quality. Slower than earlier bursts. The word 'visit' carries small ceremony. Trailing warmth, not urgency.
